scientific_scope: observation-deletion structured-variance q=1 firm-target recentering correction and convergence qualification
interpretation: Assumption-conditional evidence for FEVC's structured variance models, not unrestricted-heteroskedastic KSS variance-product evidence.

frozen_correction.remainder: component point estimate minus the leading component
frozen_correction.identity_gate: the reported remainder must reproduce y' C_t,-1 y within the complete-system residual tolerance
frozen_correction.structured_variance_role: the positive common or leverage-only fitted variance vector enters only the joint leading-score/remainder covariance and never replaces Vhat_b_t
frozen_correction.legacy_behavior: the former positive-variance recenter is retained only as a non-gating coverage diagnostic

reference_distribution.production: Counter-V1 Andrews-Mikusheva radius with at least 100000 draws per reported target
reference_distribution.qualification: deterministic inversion of the exact two-half-normal distance CDF using a 32-point Gauss-Legendre rule after endpoint regularization
independent_checks: Counter-V1 critical values against high-resolution numerical integration
Gauss-Legendre critical inversion against high-resolution Simpson integration
ellipse-image endpoints against a one-million-angle brute-force oracle

factorized_oracle.conditional_covariance: exact factorized trace, not randomized trace probes

joint_covariance_diagnostics: empirical and mean estimated leading-score variance
empirical and mean estimated remainder variance
empirical and mean estimated leading-score/remainder covariance

classification.raw_leaveout_recenter_development_pass: every oracle and fitted gate passes at dimensions 32, 48, and 64
classification.structured_variance_problem: oracle passes but fitted fails at a gated dimension
classification.q1_recenter_reference_or_remainder_probl: an oracle path fails at dimension 48 or 64 despite a numerically exact remainder identity
classification.ambiguous: any other outcome withholds confirmation and does not authorize an unregistered extension
classification.forbidden_response: no post-result threshold change, empirical calibration factor, target exclusion, or automatic dimension extension

confirmation.authorization_condition: the committed V3 development campaign has no gate failures
confirmation.promotion_rule: the V3 confirmation gates and the unchanged V1 full-matrix confirmation gates both pass before q=0 and q=1 are promoted together

public_boundary.release_binary_qualification: only after confirmation and from the exact promoted source
